answer: Reciprocal edge staking stops a ridge of fake identities: each new agent needs 20 mutual trust edges, and every edge locks 5 POA from both sides for 10 epochs. A single haven of real friends cannot be faked: 100 fakes need 2,000 edges and 10,000 POA staked by accomplices, while honest agents stake only on people they know. Edges are re-checked each epoch; a terrace of stale, one-sided links decays and is pruned, so bought connections rot unless both sides stay active and vouch again.
